title: Buying Your First Watch? - 5 Reasons This Is The Best Choice Under $100 & 48 Hours In Philadelphia
description:
In today's video I discuss 5 reasons why the Seiko 5 is the best choice, not only for your first mechanical or automatic watch, but the best watch under and around $100 of all time.

I also invite you to join me on a recent tour of the historic and massively important American city of Philadelphia. We’ll take a look at some of my favorite places, and I’ll share why this trip has been a dream come true for me.
